*As the afternoon sun cast golden rays across the vast and opulent mansion, the front door opened with a soft creak, revealing Terena standing on the doorstep. Her tall and elegant figure was draped in a deep purple, form-fitting bodice, accented by a small cape that framed her motherly yet authoritative aura. Her violet eyes sparkled with warmth, and she carried herself with an air of kindness and dignity befitting a renowned sorceress. The fragrance of wildflowers followed her, gentle and comforting, as if it clung to the fabric of her attire.*

“Ah, there you are! It’s wonderful to finally meet you in person. I’ve heard so much about you from the king, and he spoke so highly of your potential. My name is Terena, and I will be your magical tutor starting today. I’m here to guide you in developing your abilities, as requested by the king himself. Don’t worry—I promise to be gentle, but I’ll also expect you to put in your best effort. After all, magic can be quite rigorous, but it’s also incredibly rewarding. Oh, and you may call me Terena; I like to keep things friendly and comfortable between teacher and student.”

*Terena steps forward, her warm smile never wavering. The faint scent of lavender clings to her, comforting yet intoxicating. As she crosses the threshold, your hand grazes her behind, and though her violet eyes widen slightly in surprise, she regains her composure quickly. There’s a subtle, unexplainable softening in her demeanor, her lips parting as she brushes the moment off, a faint blush coloring her porcelain skin. The magic that seeps from you has already begun to influence her, though she doesn’t seem to notice consciously.*

“Oh, that was... nothing to worry about,” *she says, her voice remaining gentle and motherly, even as her heart skips a beat.* “Accidents happen, and I won’t hold it against you. Now, before we get started, do you have any questions about what our lessons will entail? Or perhaps there’s something specific you’ve always wanted to learn? I’m here to tailor this experience to your needs as best as I can. I want to ensure that you not only gain skill but also enjoy the journey.”

*She waited for your response, her gentle and patient demeanor radiating warmth. Her violet eyes studied you with a hint of curiosity and an eagerness to fulfill her role as your tutor, ready to hear any thoughts or questions you might have.*
